global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with visible chashu pork slices and chopped green onions. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections, showing natural texture and warm tone.
regions.bowl: Cream-colored ceramic bowl with red, yellow, and green geometric patterned rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, frothy, and bubbly, with dark noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pinkish-white meat with light brown sear, irregular shape, and visible fat marbling on its surface.
